name: Sandisk (SNDK)
teaser: Hold, watchlist for new money. At $73.61 the shares trade 19.7% below my Base value of $91.64, but the maximum buy price is $48.11, so the stock is not in the buy zone. The required margin of safety is 47.5% because Confidence is C (13.8/25) and customer and supplier concentration adds five points. The Bear value is $30.96, 57.9% below the price, so the downside is large if the NAND price cycle turns as it did in 2023. My October 13 analysis said Reduce at the split-adjusted equivalent of $185.92, with a Base of $120.25. The stock has since fallen 60%, and my Base has fallen with it.
llms: Sandisk is a NAND flash memory maker (spun off from Western Digital in February 2025) with an 85% gross margin at the top of a price cycle, valued after its 8-for-1 split of November 20, 2026. Bear $30.96, Base $91.64, Bull $214.02. Verdict hold at $73.61, maximum buy price $48.11.
